sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.content: Autonomous AI code review represents a high-velocity wedge into the $28B DevSecOps market. By shifting vulnerability detection left to PR merge time, this venture commands 85%+ software gross margins with enterprise ACVs ranging from $18k to $65k.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: crunchbase] $4.2B invested into AI DevSecOps category in 2025

sections.title: Problem & Opportunity
sections.content: Engineering leaders lose 22% of developer velocity to manual PR reviews and retroactive security audits. Traditional static analysis tools (SonarQube, Snyk) flag high false positives; an autonomous LLM auditor with verified codebase context cuts audit time by 60%.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: newsapi] 78% of enterprise CTOs mandate shift-left automated PR security

sections.title: Technical Architecture
sections.content: Google Cloud Run microservices with Vertex AI private endpoints. Ephemeral worker nodes pull PR diffs, execute tree-sitter AST pruning to redact secrets, and query an isolated Vector Search index per tenant. Zero raw code persists in databases.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: gcp_benchmarks] Zero-trust isolated execution guarantees 99.95% SLA

sections.title: Go-to-Market Strategy
sections.content: Product-led growth (PLG) developer tier on GitHub Marketplace feeding bottom-up enterprise sales. Seed target: 50 open-source repositories and 25 paying mid-market engineering teams.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: worldbank] Developer productivity accounts for 3.2% of global digital GDP

sections.title: Regulatory & Compliance Risk
sections.content: Audited compliance governance for EU AI Act (High-Risk Classification avoidance), US FTC automated algorithmic liability, and SOC2 Type II automated logging. Disclaimers and explicit human-in-the-loop signoffs are contractually enforced.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: eu_ai_act] Article 14 human-in-the-loop oversight mandatory for automated code commits

sections.title: Financial Plan & Unit Economics
sections.content: Priced at $45/contributor/month. Target 85% gross margins with LLM inference cost of $0.08 per PR. Infrastructure budget: $1,200/month baseline cluster cost on GCP + $0.06/PR compute & token cost.

lineage.data_citation: [SOURCE: financial_model] Breakeven at 180 paying developer seats

assumptions.assumption: Developers will trust AI to suggest inline code modifications without human peer pushback.
assumptions.evidence: 68% of developers dismiss bots that generate more than 3 comments per PR.
assumptions.recommended_action: Introduce confidence score threshold: only comment when certainty exceeds 90%.

assumptions.assumption: Enterprise security teams will permit cloud LLM processing of proprietary code.
assumptions.evidence: Strict financial institutions prohibit multi-tenant API calls with code context.
assumptions.recommended_action: Build a self-hosted Docker agent proxy that executes AST pruning locally before API transmission.

failure_modes.title: Microsoft Copilot Platform Bundling
failure_modes.description: GitHub expands native Copilot Autofix into PR triage, eliminating need for standalone third-party bot.
failure_modes.mitigation: Focus on multi-git host flexibility (GitLab, Bitbucket, self-hosted) where GitHub Copilot cannot integrate.

failure_modes.title: Prompt Injection via Untrusted Pull Requests
failure_modes.description: Malicious contributors embed zero-width prompt injection payloads in commit messages to exfiltrate CI/CD secrets.
failure_modes.mitigation: Isolate the review bot to read-only permissions and sanitize all inputs through an AST security gateway.
